title: Apply the approved initial private EKS baseline
expected_outcome: Repair the discovered node-security-group ownership conflict, import only the existing node self-ingress rule into Terraform state, then apply a reconfirmed recovery plan with no update or destroy in account 106760547719 and verify essential private-network invariants.
constraints: Inputs must remain enable_release_signer=false and enable_release_signer_ecr_mirror=false.
The recovery must only reconcile the approved initial baseline; its fresh saved plan must contain no update or destroy, pass boundary and scope gates, and match the approved account.
Import only the existing node self-ingress security-group rule after its AWS rule ID is read and validated.
Do not create ECR/release resources, mirror images, access Vault/EKS workloads, alter secrets, or record raw state/plan data.

external_actions: read AWS provider and backend state through the approved Terraform role
read the node security-group rule identity
import that existing self-ingress rule into the approved Terraform state
create a temporary saved Terraform recovery plan
apply the exact reconfirmed initial private baseline recovery plan
read back Terraform state and non-sensitive AWS resource metadata for verification

primary_owner.responsibility: apply boundary, security, cost, and final integration

delegations.escalation_trigger: fresh plan differs from approved 99-create scope or shows a destructive action
verification requires secret, workload, or unapproved account access
